title: Mustang Panda uses LSASS Memory (T1003.001)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has harvested credentials from memory of lssas.exe with [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002).(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023)

title: Mustang Panda uses Tool (T1588.002)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has obtained and leveraged publicly-available tools for intrusion activities.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023)

title: Mustang Panda uses Digital Certificates (T1588.004)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has obtained SSL certificates for their C2 domains.(Citation: EclecticIQ Mustang Panda PlugX)(Citation: Google Threat Intelligence Group MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX August 2025)

title: Mustang Panda uses Archive via Custom Method (T1560.003)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has encrypted documents with RC4 prior to exfiltration.(Citation: Avira Mustang Panda January 2020)

title: Mustang Panda uses File Deletion (T1070.004)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) will delete their tools and files, and kill processes after their objectives are reached.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: Zscaler PAKLOG CorkLog SplatCloak Splatdropper April 2025)

title: Mustang Panda uses Shared Modules (T1129)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has leveraged `LoadLibrary` to load DLLs.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)

title: Mustang Panda uses Process Discovery (T1057)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used tasklist /v to determine active process information.(Citation: Avira Mustang Panda January 2020) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also used [TONESHELL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1239) malware to check the process name and process path to ensure it matches the expected one prior to triggering a custom exception handler.(Citation: 2022 November_TrendMicro_Earth Preta_Toneshell_Pubload)

title: Mustang Panda uses System Information Discovery (T1082)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has gathered system information using systeminfo.(Citation: Avira Mustang Panda January 2020)

title: Mustang Panda uses Non-Application Layer Protocol (T1095)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has utilized TCP-based reverse shells using cmd.exe.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)

title: Mustang Panda uses Exploitation for Client Execution (T1203)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has exploited CVE-2017-0199 in Microsoft Word to execute code.(Citation: Crowdstrike MUSTANG PANDA June 2018)

title: Mustang Panda uses Executable Installer File Permissions Weakness (T1574.005)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has leveraged legitimate software installer executables such as Setup Factory “IRSetup.exe” to drop and execute their payload.(Citation: Trend Micro Mustang Panda Earth Preta Toneshell February 2025)

title: Mustang Panda uses Stage Capabilities (T1608)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used servers under their control to validate tracking pixels sent to phishing victims.(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 Europe March 2022)

title: Mustang Panda uses Debugger Evasion (T1622)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has embedded debug strings with messages to distract analysts.(Citation: 2022 November_TrendMicro_Earth Preta_Toneshell_Pubload) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also made calls to Windows API `CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent` and exits if it detects a debugger.(Citation: Sophos Mustang Panda PLUGX)

title: Mustang Panda uses Spearphishing Attachment (T1566.001)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used spearphishing attachments to deliver initial access payloads.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: CSIRT CTI MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD TONESHELL JAN 2024)(Citation: Lab52 MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD MAY 2023)(Citation: IBM MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD CLAIMLOADER JUNE 2025)(Citation: 2025_IBM_PUBLOAD_TONESHELL_HIUPAN_CLAIMLOADER_MUSTANG PANDA)(Citation: Google TAG Ukraine Threat Landscape March 2022)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Trend Micro MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD HIUPAN SEPTEMBER 2024)(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 November 2020) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also delivered archive files such as RAR and ZIP files containing legitimate EXEs and malicious DLLs.(Citation: Lab52 MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD MAY 2023)(Citation: IBM MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD CLAIMLOADER JUNE 2025)(Citation: 2025_IBM_PUBLOAD_TONESHELL_HIUPAN_CLAIMLOADER_MUSTANG PANDA)

title: Mustang Panda uses Log Enumeration (T1654)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used [Wevtutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0645) to gather Windows Security Event Logs.(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023)

title: Mustang Panda uses File and Directory Discovery (T1083)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has searched the entire target system for DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, XLS, XLSX, and PDF files.(Citation: Avira Mustang Panda January 2020)(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023)

title: Mustang Panda uses Software Discovery (T1518)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has searched the victim system for the InstallUtil.exe program and its version.(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)

title: Mustang Panda uses Domains (T1583.001)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has acquired C2 domains prior to operations.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: CSIRT CTI MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD TONESHELL JAN 2024)(Citation: Lab52 MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD MAY 2023)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Trend Micro Mustang Panda Earth Preta Toneshell February 2025)(Citation: Google Threat Intelligence Group MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX August 2025)(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015)(Citation: Palo Alto Networks, Unit 42)(Citation: McAfee Dianxun March 2021)

title: Mustang Panda uses DLL (T1574.001)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used a legitimately signed executable to execute a malicious payload within a DLL file.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Broadcom)(Citation: EclecticIQ Mustang Panda PlugX)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023)(Citation: Trend Micro Mustang Panda Earth Preta Toneshell February 2025)(Citation: 2022 November_TrendMicro_Earth Preta_Toneshell_Pubload)(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 November 2020)(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015)(Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022)(Citation: Zscaler PAKLOG CorkLog SplatCloak Splatdropper April 2025)(Citation: Zscaler) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has abused legitimate executables to side-load malicious DLLs.(Citation: CSIRT CTI MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD TONESHELL JAN 2024)(Citation: Lab52 MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD MAY 2023)(Citation: IBM MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD CLAIMLOADER JUNE 2025)(Citation: 2025_IBM_PUBLOAD_TONESHELL_HIUPAN_CLAIMLOADER_MUSTANG PANDA)(Citation: Google Threat Intelligence Group MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX August 2025)

title: Mustang Panda uses Windows Management Instrumentation Event Subscription (T1546.003)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129)'s custom ORat tool uses a WMI event consumer to maintain persistence.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)

title: Mustang Panda uses Native API (T1106)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used various Windows API calls during execution and defense evasion.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Broadcom)(Citation: Lab52 MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD MAY 2023)(Citation: IBM MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD CLAIMLOADER JUNE 2025)(Citation: 2025_IBM_PUBLOAD_TONESHELL_HIUPAN_CLAIMLOADER_MUSTANG PANDA)(Citation: Trend Micro Mustang Panda Earth Preta Toneshell February 2025)(Citation: 2022 November_TrendMicro_Earth Preta_Toneshell_Pubload)(Citation: Google Threat Intelligence Group MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX August 2025)(Citation: Palo Alto Networks, Unit 42)(Citation: Sophos Mustang Panda PLUGX)(Citation: Zscaler PAKLOG CorkLog SplatCloak Splatdropper April 2025)(Citation: Zscaler)

title: Mustang Panda uses NTDS (T1003.003)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used vssadmin to create a volume shadow copy and retrieve the NTDS.dit file. [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also used reg save on the SYSTEM file Registry location to help extract the NTDS.dit file.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023)

title: Mustang Panda uses Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has utilized meterpreter shellcode.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)

title: Mustang Panda uses Code Signing (T1553.002)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used valid legitimate digital signatures and certificates to evade detection.(Citation: CSIRT CTI MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD TONESHELL JAN 2024)(Citation: Lab52 MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD MAY 2023)(Citation: Google Threat Intelligence Group MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX August 2025)(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015)(Citation: Palo Alto Networks, Unit 42)(Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022)(Citation: Zscaler PAKLOG CorkLog SplatCloak Splatdropper April 2025)(Citation: Zscaler)

title: Mustang Panda uses Obfuscated Files or Information (T1027)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has delivered initial payloads hidden using archives and encoding measures.(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Crowdstrike MUSTANG PANDA June 2018)(Citation: 2022 November_TrendMicro_Earth Preta_Toneshell_Pubload)(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 November 2020)(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 Europe March 2022)(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015) (Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022)(Citation: Zscaler PAKLOG CorkLog SplatCloak Splatdropper April 2025)(Citation: Zscaler) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also utilized opaque predicates in payloads to hinder analysis.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)

title: Mustang Panda uses Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder (T1547.001)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has created the registry key HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\AdobelmdyU to maintain persistence.(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 November 2020) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also established persistence via the registry key `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`.(Citation: EclecticIQ Mustang Panda PlugX)(Citation: Sophos Mustang Panda PLUGX)

title: Mustang Panda uses Automated Collection (T1119)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) used custom batch scripts to collect files automatically from a targeted system.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)

title: Mustang Panda uses Ingress Tool Transfer (T1105)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has downloaded additional executables following the initial infection stage.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also leveraged Visual Studio Code `code.exe` and Dev Tunnels using `DevTunnel.exe` to propagate additional tools and payloads.(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)

title: Mustang Panda uses Local Data Staging (T1074.001)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has stored collected credential files in c:\windows\temp prior to exfiltration. [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also stored documents for exfiltration in a hidden folder on USB drives.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: Avira Mustang Panda January 2020)

title: Mustang Panda uses JavaScript (T1059.007)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has executed a JavaScript payload utilizing wscript.exe on the endpoint.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)

title: Mustang Panda uses PowerShell (T1059.001)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used malicious PowerShell scripts to enable execution.(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: Crowdstrike MUSTANG PANDA June 2018)(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)

title: Mustang Panda uses Junk Code Insertion (T1027.016)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used junk code within their DLL files to hinder analysis.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Avira Mustang Panda January 2020)

title: Mustang Panda uses Timestomp (T1070.006)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has modified file timestamps from the export address table (EAT) in malware to make it difficult to identify creation times.(Citation: Palo Alto Networks, Unit 42)

title: Mustang Panda uses Malicious File (T1204.002)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has sent malicious files requiring direct victim interaction to execute.(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: CSIRT CTI MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD TONESHELL JAN 2024)(Citation: IBM MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD CLAIMLOADER JUNE 2025)(Citation: 2025_IBM_PUBLOAD_TONESHELL_HIUPAN_CLAIMLOADER_MUSTANG PANDA)(Citation: Avira Mustang Panda January 2020)(Citation: Google TAG Ukraine Threat Landscape March 2022)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Crowdstrike MUSTANG PANDA June 2018)(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 Europe March 2022)(Citation: Zscaler PAKLOG CorkLog SplatCloak Splatdropper April 2025) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also leveraged executable files that display decoy documents to the victim to provide a resemblance of legitimacy with customized themes related to the victim.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Lab52 MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD MAY 2023)(Citation: EclecticIQ Mustang Panda PlugX)(Citation: Trend Micro MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD HIUPAN SEPTEMBER 2024)(Citation: Trend Micro Mustang Panda Earth Preta Toneshell February 2025)(Citation: 2022 November_TrendMicro_Earth Preta_Toneshell_Pubload)(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015)(Citation: Palo Alto Networks, Unit 42)(Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022)(Citation: Sophos Mustang Panda PLUGX)

title: Mustang Panda uses Protocol Tunneling (T1572)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has leveraged OpenSSH (sshd.exe) to execute commands, transfer files and spread across the environment communicating over SMB port 445.(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)

title: Mustang Panda uses Masquerade File Type (T1036.008)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has masqueraded malicious executables as legitimate files that download [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013) malware.(Citation: EclecticIQ Mustang Panda PlugX)(Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022)

title: Mustang Panda uses Double File Extension (T1036.007)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used an additional filename extension to hide the true file type.(Citation: Crowdstrike MUSTANG PANDA June 2018)(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)

title: Mustang Panda uses Web Service (T1102)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used DropBox URLs to deliver variants of [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013).(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 Europe March 2022) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also used Google Drive to host malicious downloads.(Citation: IBM MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD CLAIMLOADER JUNE 2025)

title: Mustang Panda uses Traffic Signaling (T1205)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has utilized a magic value in C2 communications and only executes in memory when response packets match specific values of “17 03 03” or “46 77 4d”.(Citation: CSIRT CTI MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD TONESHELL JAN 2024)

title: Mustang Panda uses Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location (T1036.005)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used names like `adobeupdate.dat` and `PotPlayerDB.dat` to disguise [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013), and a file named `OneDrive.exe` to load a [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) payload.(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also masqueraded legitimate browser plugin updates to include AdobePlugins.exe.(Citation: Google Threat Intelligence Group MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX August 2025)

title: Mustang Panda uses Malware (T1587.001)

title: Mustang Panda uses LNK Icon Smuggling (T1027.012)
text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has utilized LNK files to hide malicious scripts for execution.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Sophos Mustang Panda PLUGX) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also leveraged LNK files that were programmed to display a PDF icon to entice the victim to click on the file to execute an office.exe binary.(Citation: CSIRT CTI MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD TONESHELL JAN 2024)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses System Information Discovery (T1082)

text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) targeted presidential campaign staffers with credential phishing e-mails.(Citation: Google Election Threats October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Query Registry (T1012)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used a tool to query the Registry for proxy settings.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Hide Infrastructure (T1665)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has utilized an ORB (operational relay box) network – consisting compromised devices such as small office and home office (SOHO) routers, IoT devices, and leased virtual private servers (VPS) – to obfuscate the origin of C2 traffic.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Windows Command Shell (T1059.003)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Web Services (T1583.006)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used GitHub to host malware linked in spearphishing e-mails.(Citation: Google Election Threats October 2020)(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Network Devices (T1584.008)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has compromised network devices such as small office and home office (SOHO) routers and IoT devices for ORB (operational relay box) [Proxy](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1090) networks.(Citation: ORB APT31)(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Credentials from Web Browsers (T1555.003)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used a tool to steal credentials from installed web browsers including Microsoft Internet Explorer and Google Chrome.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Python (T1059.006)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used Python-based implants to interact with compromised hosts.(Citation: Google Election Threats October 2020)(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder (T1547.001)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has created a Registry Run key named Dropbox Update Setup to establish persistence for a malicious Python binary.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Symmetric Cryptography (T1573.001)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used AES encrypted communications in C2.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses System Time Discovery (T1124)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used a tool to capture the time on a compromised host in order to register it with C2.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information (T1140)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used the AES256 algorithm with a SHA1 derived key to decrypt exploit code.(Citation: Check Point APT31 February 2021)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Spearphishing Link (T1598.003)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used web beacons in e-mails to track hits to attacker-controlled URL's.(Citation: Microsoft Targeting Elections September 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Spearphishing Link (T1566.002)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used malicious links in e-mails to deliver malware.(Citation: Microsoft Targeting Elections September 2020)(Citation: Google Election Threats October 2020)(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Domains (T1583.001)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has purchased domains for use in targeted campaigns.(Citation: Microsoft Targeting Elections September 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses System Owner/User Discovery (T1033)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used a tool to capture the username on a compromised host in order to register it with C2.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Multi-hop Proxy (T1090.003)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has utilized an ORB (operational relay box) network – consisting compromised devices such as small office and home office (SOHO) routers, IoT devices, and leased virtual private servers (VPS) – to proxy traffic.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Exfiltration Over C2 Channel (T1041)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has exfiltrated files via the Dropbox API C2.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Masquerading (T1036)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has spoofed legitimate applications in phishing lures and changed file extensions to conceal  installation of malware.(Citation: Google Election Threats October 2020)(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Exfiltration to Cloud Storage (T1567.002)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has exfiltrated stolen data to Dropbox.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Software Packing (T1027.002)
text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used multi-stage packers for exploit code.(Citation: Check Point APT31 February 2021)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Masquerade Task or Service (T1036.004)

title: ZIRCONIUM uses Ingress Tool Transfer (T1105)

title: Rocke uses Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190)

text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has modified UPX headers after packing files to break unpackers.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Web Service (T1102)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has used Pastebin, Gitee, and GitLab for Command and Control.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

title: Rocke uses Unix Shell (T1059.004)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) used shell scripts to run commands which would obtain persistence and execute the cryptocurrency mining malware.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

title: Rocke uses System Information Discovery (T1082)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has used uname -m to collect the name and information about the infected system's kernel.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Application Layer Protocol (T1071)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) issued wget requests from infected systems to the C2.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

title: Rocke uses Ingress Tool Transfer (T1105)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) used malware to download additional malicious files to the target system.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

title: Rocke uses Compute Hijacking (T1496.001)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has distributed cryptomining malware.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Rocke January 2019)

title: Rocke uses Compile After Delivery (T1027.004)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has compiled malware, delivered to victims as .c files, with the GNU Compiler Collection (GCC).(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Dynamic Linker Hijacking (T1574.006)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has modified /etc/ld.so.preload to hook libc functions in order to hide the installed dropper and mining software in process lists.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Hidden Files and Directories (T1564.001)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) downloaded a file "libprocesshider", which could hide files on the target system.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Rocke January 2019)

title: Rocke uses Cron (T1053.003)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) installed a cron job that downloaded and executed files from the C2.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Rocke January 2019)(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Python (T1059.006)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has used Python-based malware to install and spread their coinminer.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Network Service Discovery (T1046)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) conducted scanning for exposed TCP port 7001 as well as SSH and Redis servers.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Portable Executable Injection (T1055.002)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106)'s miner, "TermsHost.exe", evaded defenses by injecting itself into Windows processes, including Notepad.exe.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

title: Rocke uses Dead Drop Resolver (T1102.001)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has used Pastebin to check the version of beaconing malware and redirect to another Pastebin hosting updated malware.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts (T1037)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has installed an "init.d" startup script to maintain persistence.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Software Packing (T1027.002)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106)'s miner has created UPX-packed files in the Windows Start Menu Folder.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Rocke January 2019)(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder (T1547.001)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106)'s miner has created UPX-packed files in the Windows Start Menu Folder.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

title: Rocke uses Linux and Mac Permissions (T1222.002)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has changed file permissions of files so they could not be modified.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Process Discovery (T1057)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) can detect a running process's PID on the infected machine.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Systemd Service (T1543.002)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has installed a systemd service script to maintain persistence.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Remote System Discovery (T1018)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has looked for IP addresses in the known_hosts file on the infected system and attempted to SSH into them.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

title: Rocke uses Disable or Modify System Firewall (T1686)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) used scripts which killed processes and added firewall rules to block traffic related to other cryptominers.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

title: Rocke uses Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information (T1140)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has extracted tar.gz files after downloading them from a C2 server.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

title: Rocke uses Clear Linux or Mac System Logs (T1685.006)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has cleared log files within the /var/log/ folder.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

metadata.technique_name: Clear Linux or Mac System Logs

title: Rocke uses Private Keys (T1552.004)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has used SSH private keys on the infected machine to spread its coinminer throughout a network.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses File Deletion (T1070.004)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has deleted files on infected machines.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Web Protocols (T1071.001)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has executed wget and curl commands to Pastebin over the HTTPS protocol.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Disable or Modify Tools (T1685)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) used scripts which detected and uninstalled antivirus software.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Rocke January 2019)

title: Rocke uses Non-Standard Port (T1571)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106)'s miner connects to a C2 server using port 51640.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses SSH (T1021.004)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has spread its coinminer via SSH.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Timestomp (T1070.006)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has changed the time stamp of certain files.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

title: Rocke uses Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location (T1036.005)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has used shell scripts which download mining executables and saves them with the filename "java".(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

metadata.technique_name: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location

title: Rocke uses Security Software Discovery (T1518.001)
text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) used scripts which detected and uninstalled antivirus software.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Rocke January 2019)

title: Scattered Spider uses Phishing for Information (T1598)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used a combination of credential phishing and social engineering to capture one-time-password (OTP) codes.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider BYOVD January 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Disable or Modify Tools (T1685)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has uninstalled and disabled security tools.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Code Signing (T1553.002)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used self-signed and stolen certificates originally issued to NVIDIA and Global Software LLC.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider BYOVD January 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Conditional Access Policies (T1556.009)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has added additional trusted locations to Azure AD conditional access policies. (Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Cloud Infrastructure Discovery (T1580)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) enumerates cloud environments including Amazon Web Services (AWS) S3 buckets to identify server and backup management infrastructure, resource access, databases and storage containers .(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Ingress Tool Transfer (T1105)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has downloaded the Teleport remote access tool to compromised VMware vCenter Servers.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Email Forwarding Rule (T1114.003)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has redirected emails notifying users of suspicious account activity.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Spearphishing Link (T1598.003)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used domains mirroring corporate login portals to socially engineer victims into providing credentials.(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Valid Accounts (T1078)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used compromised credentials for initial access.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses NTDS (T1003.003)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has extracted the `NTDS.dit` file by creating volume shadow copies of virtual domain controller disks.(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Exfiltration Over C2 Channel (T1041)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has exfiltrated data from compromised VMware vCenter servers through an established C2 channel using the Teleport remote access tool.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Domain Account (T1087.002)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has enumerated legitimate domain accounts which are used in the targeted environment.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Trust Modification (T1484.002)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) adds a federated identity provider to the victim’s SSO tenant and activates automatic account linking.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Account Discovery (T1087)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has identified vSphere administrator accounts.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Social Media Accounts (T1585.001)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has created matching fake social media profiles to support new accounts created in victim environments.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Steal Web Session Cookie (T1539)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) retrieves browser cookies via Raccoon Stealer.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Tool (T1588.002)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has obtained tools for use throughout the attack lifecycle to include remote access software, protocol tunneling and proxy tools, exploitation frameworks, and reconnaissance tools.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Private Keys (T1552.004)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) enumerate and exfiltrate code-signing certificates from a compromised host.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Gather Victim Identity Information (T1589)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used information from previous data breaches to identify employee names to be used in social engineering.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Cloud Service Dashboard (T1538)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) abused AWS Systems Manager Inventory to identify targets on the compromised network prior to lateral movement.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Data Encrypted for Impact (T1486)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used [BlackCat](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1068) and DragonForce ransomware to encrypt files including on VMWare ESXi servers.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Unix Shell (T1059.004)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used the command shell to upload and install the Teleport remote access tool to a compromised vCenter Server Appliance.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses External Remote Services (T1133)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has leveraged legitimate remote management tools to maintain persistent access.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider BYOVD January 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses SSH (T1021.004)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used SSH to move laterally in victim environments and to access the vSphere vCenter Server GUI.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses User Execution (T1204)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has impersonated organization IT and helpdesk staff to instruct victims to execute commercial remote access tools to gain initial access.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Multi-Factor Authentication (T1556.006)
text: After compromising user accounts, [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) registers their own MFA tokens.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Impersonation (T1684.001)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) utilized social engineering to compel IT help desk personnel to reset passwords and MFA tokens.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023) [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has also used Microsoft Teams to pose as internal IT support or help desk personnel.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Domains (T1583.001)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has registered domains to spoof legitimate corporate login portals.(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses System Network Configuration Discovery (T1016)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used network reconnaissance commands for discovery including `ping` and `nltest`.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses File and Directory Discovery (T1083)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) Spider enumerates a target organization for files and directories of interest, including source code, user provisioning, MFA device registration, network diagrams, and shared credentials in documents or spreadsheets.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Systemd Service (T1543.002)
text:
[Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has run `SYSTEMD_UNIT_PATH="/lib/systemd/
system/teleport.service` to establish persistence for the Teleport remote access tool.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Remote Desktop Software (T1219.002)
text: In addition to directing victims to run remote software, [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) members themselves also deploy RMM software including TeamViewer, AnyDesk, LogMeIn, [ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508), and [ConnectWise](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0591) to establish persistence on the compromised network.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: Trellix Scattered Spider MO August 2023)(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Financial Theft (T1657)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has deployed ransomware on compromised hosts and threatened to leak stolen data for financial gain.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: Trellix Scattered Spider MO August 2023)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Code Repositories (T1213.003)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) enumerates data stored within victim code repositories, such as internal GitHub repositories.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Additional Cloud Roles (T1098.003)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has assigned user access admin roles in order to gain Tenant Root Group management permissions in Azure.(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Permission Groups Discovery (T1069)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has enumerated the vSphere Admins and ESX Admins groups in targeted environments.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Multi-Factor Authentication Request Generation (T1621)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used multifactor authentication (MFA) fatigue by sending repeated MFA authentication requests to targets.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider BYOVD January 2023)(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses System Information Discovery (T1082)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has executed scripts to identify the underlying operating system to ensure it uses the correct installation package for malicious payloads.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Remote Desktop Protocol (T1021.001)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used RDP to enable lateral movement.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Account Manipulation (T1098)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has added accounts to the ESX Admins group to grant them full admin rights in vSphere.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Messaging Applications (T1213.005)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) threat actors search the victim’s Slack and Microsoft Teams for conversations about the intrusion and incident response.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Exploitation for Privilege Escalation (T1068)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has deployed a malicious kernel driver through exploitation of CVE-2015-2291 in the Intel Ethernet diagnostics driver for Windows (iqvw64.sys).(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider BYOVD January 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Proxy (T1090)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used proxy networks to hamper detection and has installed legitimate proxy tools on VMware vCenter and adversary-controlled VMs.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Data from Cloud Storage (T1530)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) enumerates data stored in cloud resources for collection and exfiltration purposes.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Browser Information Discovery (T1217)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) retrieves browser histories via infostealer malware such as Raccoon Stealer.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Direct Volume Access (T1006)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has created volume shadow copies of virtual domain controller disks to extract the `NTDS.dit` file.(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Create Account (T1136)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) creates new user identities within the compromised organization.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Inhibit System Recovery (T1490)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has stopped the Volume Shadow Copy service on compromised hosts.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Remote System Discovery (T1018)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) can enumerate remote systems, such as VMware vCenter infrastructure.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Domain Groups (T1069.002)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has enumerated Active Directory security groups including through the use of ADExplorer, ADRecon.ps1, and Get-ADUser.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses PowerShell (T1059.001)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used the PowerShell cmdlet Get-ADUser.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Password Managers (T1555.005)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has searched for credentials in password vaults and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions including HashiCorp Vault.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Exfiltration to Cloud Storage (T1567.002)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has exfiltrated victim data to the MEGA file sharing site, SnowFlake, and AWS S3 buckets.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Spearphishing Voice (T1598.004)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used help desk voice-based phishing and also called employees at target organizations and compelled them to navigate to fake login portals using adversary-in-the-middle toolkits.(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Data Staged (T1074)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) stages data in a centralized database prior to exfiltration.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Cloud Accounts (T1078.004)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used compromised Microsoft Entra ID accounts to pivot in victim environments.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Clear Mailbox Data (T1070.008)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has manually deleted emails notifying users of suspicious account activity.  (Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Cloud Services (T1021.007)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has also leveraged pre-existing AWS EC2 instances for lateral movement and data collection purposes.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Protocol Tunneling (T1572)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has installed protocol-tunneling tools on VMware vCenter and adversary-controlled VMs, including Teleport.sh, Chisel (configured to communicate with trycloudflare[.]com subdomains), MobaXterm, ngrok, Pinggy, and Teleport.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Create Cloud Instance (T1578.002)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has created Amazon EC2 instances within the victim's environment.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Credentials In Files (T1552.001)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) Spider searches for credential storage documentation on a compromised host.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Email Collection (T1114)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) searched the victim’s Microsoft Exchange for emails about the intrusion and incident response.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

title: Scattered Spider uses Malware (T1588.001)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has obtained malware to use at multiple stages of operations including information stealers, remote access tools, and ransomware.(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

title: Scattered Spider uses Email Hiding Rules (T1564.008)
text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) creates inbound rules on the compromised email accounts of security personnel to automatically delete emails from vendor security products.(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)

title: APT39 uses Network Service Discovery (T1046)
text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has used [CrackMapExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0488) and a custom port scanner known as BLUETORCH for network scanning.(Citation: FireEye APT39 Jan 2019)(Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020)

title: APT39 uses Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder (T1547.001)
text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has maintained persistence using the startup folder.(Citation: FireEye APT39 Jan 2019)

title: APT39 uses External Proxy (T1090.002)
text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has used various tools to proxy C2 communications.(Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020)

title: APT39 uses Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information (T1140)
text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has used malware to decrypt encrypted CAB files.(Citation: FBI FLASH APT39 September 2020)

title: APT39 uses Keylogging (T1056.001)
text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has used tools for capturing keystrokes.(Citation: Symantec Chafer February 2018)(Citation: FBI FLASH APT39 September 2020)

title: APT39 uses Data from Local System (T1005)
